$comment: Sanitized template of the Etabli MCP server set, mirroring the Claude user-scope shape (~/.claude.json mcpServers). Copy entries into your live config and export the referenced environment variables; never commit real tokens. See docs/mcp-strategy.md. Pi consumes this set through ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json imports:["claude-code"] — do not duplicate server definitions on the Pi side.
$linear_gap: The linear-* skills require a Linear MCP server, which is intentionally not preconfigured (OAuth + workspace-specific). To enable: add a user-scope http server "linear" with url https://mcp.linear.app/mcp and complete OAuth in the host. See docs/mcp-strategy.md.
